title: Metal Cutting Band Saws in Canada | Bekamak Premium & NovoFab Value | NovoTech
meta_description: Horizontal metal cutting band saws in Canada in two lines — premium Bekamak (Turkey) and NovoTech's own NovoFab Machinery value line: manual, semi-automatic, automatic and double-column saws from Ø9″ to 59″, capacity tables and a band saw buying guide.
intro: Horizontal band saws for steel fabricators, machine shops and steel service centres across Canada, in two clearly separated lines: the premium Bekamak range built in Turkey, and NovoTech's own NovoFab Machinery value line. Each line has its own pages for manual gravity-feed saws, semi-automatic saws with hydraulic vise, fully automatic NC saws with powered feeding, and double-column saws for heavy bar and bundles — every machine with a CSA-approved panel, spare parts and technical support from Mississauga.

article_intro: Everything we explain to customers before they buy a band saw: how horizontal saws work, pivot versus double-column, manual versus automatic, blade selection, speeds and feeds, and a troubleshooting chart. Written by NovoTech's technicians from years of installing and servicing band saws in Canada.
faq_title: Questions we get asked about band saws

faq.q: What is the difference between the Premium and Value lines?
faq.a: Premium-line saws are built by Bekamak in Turkey with European components and the heaviest construction in their class. Value-line saws carry NovoTech's own NovoFab Machinery brand: proven designs built to our specification at a lower price. Each line has its own pages on this site so you can compare like with like. Both lines come with a CSA-approved electrical panel, a 1-year warranty and spare parts and technical support from Mississauga.

faq.q: How do I choose the size of a band saw?
faq.a: Start with the largest round or rectangular stock you cut regularly and add about 1–2 in (25–50 mm) of clearance. Bekamak model numbers give the round capacity in millimetres (BMSY 440 = 440 mm) and NovoFab model numbers give it in inches (NF-H 18 = 18″). Then decide how much automation you need — manual, semi-automatic or automatic — and whether you cut miters. The buying guide on this page walks through each choice.

faq.q: Which saws can cut bundles of tube or bar?
faq.a: Semi-automatic and automatic saws with a hydraulic top clamp can cut bundles; the double-column CS and CGS NC models and the Bekamak XS line are designed for bundle cutting with servo feeding. Ask us for the bundle size of the model you are considering.

faq.q: Do the saws come with a blade and coolant system?
faq.a: Yes — every band saw ships with a bi-metal blade, an electric coolant pump and a blade brush. We stock replacement blades for all sizes in Mississauga.

faq.q: Can I get a saw for 208 V, 240 V or 480 V?
faq.a: Three-phase saws are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request. Some small manual saws are available in single-phase.
Yes. Installation and operator training are available across Canada, and spare parts, blades and technical support are handled from our Mississauga location.
